products.name: Pomade Paste
page_lines: One jar.
Every texture.
Pomade Paste is a whipped, light paste that melts in your hands and gives you hold and shine with no grease and no flakes.
It lays waves down, defines curls, keeps a beard line clean, and holds a slick-back or a bun.
It washes out clean.
How to use it Scoop a dime-sized amount.
Warm it between your palms.
Work it in from root to tip.
Brush it through for waves, finger-style it for curls, smooth it down for a beard, slick-back or bun.
Need more hold?
Add a little more and build from there.
Who it's forWaves, curls, beards, slick-backs and buns.
Fresh cut or deep in your wolfing phase, it works at every stage.

products.name: Brush (Your Hair)
page_lines: Brush Your Hair.
The motto is the product.
It's a curved brush with 100% boar bristles in a soft/medium feel.
The curve follows the shape of your head and jaw, so every stroke covers more of your waves or beard.
It grips your hair without pulling.
How to use it Waves: use long, steady strokes from the crown outward to lay your pattern.
Fresh cut: let the bristles glide light so you don't rough up the cut.
Wolfing or beard: use steady pressure to lay every strand down.
Brush it through after Pomade Paste for hold and shine.
Who it's forWaves at every stage, fresh fades, wolfers and beards.

products.name: Glory Double-sided Checkered Durag
page_lines: The last step of the routine.
This is Glory's own double-sided checkered durag, designed and sold by Glory.
It's reversible, with two looks in one.
It has a smooth, silk-like feel, wide, long straps, and outer seams stitched so they don't leave lines on your forehead.
Put it on after you brush, and it keeps your waves laid and your moisture in, overnight or through the day.

Lay your pattern with the Brush (Your Hair).
Pull the durag smoothly over your crown.
Tie the wide, flat straps snug but not tight.
No tension.
Wear it overnight or during the day.
Who it's forWaves and curls at every stage, especially when you're wolfing.
